source: A profiler therefore needs more than “load count.” Nsight exposes requests, sectors, hit rates, bytes, and utilization across L1, L2, and ZXNAME0000XZ interfaces. Those counters help answer where traffic expanded, where reuse was captured, and which link approached its throughput ceiling.[3]
zh: 因此，分析器需要的不仅仅是“负载计数”。 Nsight 跨 L1、L2 和 ZXNAME0000XZ 接口公开请求、扇区、命中率、字节和利用率。这些计数器有助于回答流量在哪里扩展、在哪里捕获重用以及哪个链路接近其吞吐量上限。 [3]
